thread:
emily-cs: @sasha-oncall customer acme_inc reports repeated 503s for /v1/generate around 12:13UTC. request_id=req_0a1b2c3. they mention timeouts and a segfault on our side during a tool_call with a very large context. can we triage? :exclamation:

sasha-oncall: looking. can you paste the request id + the last 10s of logs from the node? i'll check runner and gateway traces.

emily-cs: pasted logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:13:27Z runner[pid=4321]: segfault at 0x0 (signal 11)
2026-03-15T12:13:27Z infer-gpu: nvml memory used 40328MB / 49152MB
2026-03-15T12:13:27Z container: OOMExit code=137
```
customer says it happened while executing a tool_call and sending ~20k tokens as context.

lee-ml: tagging in. early hypothesis: KV prefetch + tool_call with huge context can duplicate KV across beams and spike GPU memory. pulling metrics for that runner now.

mike-dev: deploy-bot shows a runtime hot-swap earlier this morning — quantized runtime v2.3.4 pushed at 11:50. could be related.

deploy-bot: rolled back image redwood/infer:canary-2026-03-15-quant-swap -> redwood/infer:stable-2026-03-01

sasha-oncall: good — lee, can you confirm whether the segfaults correlate with the quant runtime rollout? also collect core dump + gdb backtrace: `gdb -c core ./infer -ex 'bt' -ex quit`

lee-ml: correlation present. the 12:13:27 segfault lines up with the quant runtime module load on that node. core shows SIGSEGV inside the attention kernel (attn.cu:~212). nvprof traces reveal an unusual memory-copy pattern during prefetch that doubles allocation for large contexts.

mike-dev: short-term mitigations: bump per-container cgroup mem to 64GB, enable fallback routing for this customer's traffic to dedicated capacity, and pin them to stable runtime. also suggest enabling prefix-cache to avoid aggressive KV prefetch.

emily-cs: i'll relay temp workarounds to the customer: 1) reduce context size, 2) switch to dedicated instance (if feasible), or 3) we'll pin them to stable runtime. drafting note now. :pray:

sasha-oncall: ops-bot, create an incident ticket and schedule a hotfix deploy after eng confirms repro. include repro steps and affected request ids.

ops-bot: incident INC-20260315-078 created. assigned: eng-ml, eng-runtime. priority: P1.

sasha-oncall: repro steps for eng: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-large", "input":"<20k tokens>", "tool_call":true}'
```
run this against a canary node with quant runtime v2.3.4 and monitor nvml / core generation.

lee-ml: collecting core + nvml + nvprof traces now. initial fix looks like bounds-check patch in attention kernel and de-duplicating KV per-beam. will post dicey stack traces shortly.

emily-cs: customer reports errors dropped after we rolled them back to stable runtime. i'll confirm tomorrow if they want us to fully migrate them off canary. thanks all :thumbsup:
